title: Ready, episode 4: out of your depth
needs: NEW: the girl, about eleven, starting her own timer on a tablet while her dad nods from the kitchen
SCREEN: the trust ladder picker (Ask first, They start you watch, Trusted) needs a /ref page and a capture; it would replace the ask box screen

beats.quote: Almost half of parents feel their child knows more about tech than they do.

beats.me: She knows this stuff better than I do. Where do I even start?

digi: Today: you do not need to know the app. You need the words.
Every day: ten minutes together, and I give you the words.
As she grows: she moves up from asking first to trusted.

beats.line: Ten minutes a day, learning together.
At first, she asks. You decide.
She knows the app. And she knows why.
